note: A thesis on data driven wildfire risk models for Canada from multisource Earth observation, which outperformed the operational Fire Weather Index, so the System was a benchmark only.

title: Quantifying the current and future likelihood of the 2022 extreme wildfires weather conditions in France with anthropogenic climatechange
note: This conference abstract repeated the 2026 NHESS article 10.5194/nhess-26-2637-2026 on the rarity and attribution of 2022 Fire Weather Index conditions in southwestern France, which did not evaluate the System.

title: A Digital Twin for Wildfire risk adaptation planning: DT-WILDFIRE
note: A conference abstract on a Barcelona wildfire digital twin that computed the Fire Weather Index at 1.5 km from the EMO1 database and validated it against ERA5-Land values, an evaluation of System inputs.

title: CLIMAAX M16 Deliverable 2 & Annex_Clisthenes_Aigaleo
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
note: A CLIMAAX project deliverable on a neighbourhood scale climate risk assessment for Aigaleo, with Fire Weather Index projections as one hazard indicator, so the System was not evaluated.

title: Attribution of landscape fires to warfare vs peacetime drivers
note: A conference abstract attributing Ukrainian landscape fires to warfare by comparing fire area across Fire Weather Index classes in buffer and controlled zones, so the System was a stratifier only.

title: GIS-Based Mapping of Wildfire Risk and Resilience in Cultural Landscapes
note: A conference abstract on GIS mapping of wildfire risk and resilience in Norwegian and Spanish cultural landscapes with projected Fire Weather Index layers, its remark on Norwegian underrating a side finding.

title: Supplementary Code Torres-Vázquez et al. (2026): Harmonised Medium Resolution Burned Area product
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
note: A Zenodo repository of code for a harmonised medium resolution burned area product, a supplementary record with no method of its own.

title: How do future land-use changes jointly influence summer land–atmosphere coupling and fire danger across Europe?
note: A conference abstract on WRF simulations of future land use effects on land atmosphere coupling and fire danger across Europe, a projection study using the System as an output.

title: A Review of Machine Learning Approaches for Wildfire Prediction and Management in Australia: Challenges, Data Integration and Future Directions
venue: European Journal of Forest Engineering
note: A review of machine learning for wildfire prediction and management in Australia that treated fire weather indices as a past practice, with no System component evaluated.

title: Optimizing Fine-Tuning of Earth Foundation Models via Multidimensional Latin Hypercube Sampling for Small-Scale Burn Scar Identification
venue: Fire
note: A Prithvi Earth foundation model was fine tuned with Latin hypercube sampling to map small burn scars, with fire weather indices only as a sampling dimension, so the System was not evaluated.

title: State of Wildfires 2025-26: Anomalies in Extreme Fire Weather Days by Continent, Biome, Country, and Administrative Region
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
note: A Zenodo dataset of regional anomalies in extreme Fire Weather Index days from ERA5 for the State of Wildfires 2025 to 2026 report, a dataset record with no method of its own.

title: Daily historical fire weather indices averaged over 21 Alaska Predictive Service Areas (PSAs) at elevations at or below 600m for 1979-2017
venue: USGS DOI Tool Production Environment
note: A USGS dataset of daily drought and fire weather indices averaged over 21 Alaska Predictive Service Areas from downscaled ERA-Interim for 1979 to 2017, a dataset record with no method of its own.

title: WRF-Based High-Resolution Fire Weather Forecasting: Accuracy, Uncertainty, and Applications
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
note: WRF hourly forecasts of temperature, humidity, wind and derived fire weather indices were verified against ground observations with nonlinear error amplification in the indices, a forecast input evaluation in which the indices were not named.

title: Codes and data related to the article: Renard et al. A Joint Space-Time Probabilistic Model for Agricultural Droughts, Hydrological Droughts and Fire Weather in France. NHESS.
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
note: A Zenodo package of R code and data for the Renard and others NHESS article on joint drought and fire weather hazards in France, preprint 10.5194/egusphere-2026-1406, a code record with no method of its own.

title: Data and code for: "Predicting fire refugia formation and their role in Pinus nigra recovery following stand-replacing fires" in Ecological Applications
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
note: A Zenodo deposit of data and rasters for a study of fire refugia and Pinus nigra recovery, a dataset record with no method of its own.

title: Preconditioning Drought and Fire Weather Jointly Elevate Megafire Risk in the Western United States
note: Joint rarity of antecedent drought and fire weather was related to megafire rates for 19,761 western United States fires from 1984 to 2024, so fire weather was a covariate only.

title: Incendios_PY: a reproducible computational framework for decoupled wildfire ignition and propagation benchmarking in the Gran Chaco
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
note: A Zenodo software release of a Paraguayan wildfire ignition and propagation pipeline benchmarked against the Canadian Fire Weather Index and INPE Risco de Fogo, a code record with no results of its own.

title: IgniWise Dataset — Prescribed Burn Window Prediction for Spain (1983–2015)
note: A Zenodo dataset and trained random forest for prescribed burn windows in Spanish provinces with Fire Weather Index features, a dataset record with no method evaluating the System.

title: Research Data and Code for "Order Now or Wait? Testing a Sequential Wildfire Evacuation Rule against Fixed Triggers in North-East Attica"
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
note: A Zenodo package of code and results for an article testing a sequential evacuation rule in north east Attica with ERA5 Fire Weather Index inputs, a data record with no method of its own.

title: From Observation to Attribution: nudged atmospheric circulation simulations to attribute burned area trends
note: This conference abstract repeated the EGU 2026 abstract 10.5194/egusphere-egu26-11842 on nudged CESM2 burned area simulations compared with GFED5 for attribution, which did not evaluate the System.

title: Meteorological data 2025 wildifre season in NW Spain
venue: ScienceDB
note: A ScienceDB dataset of ERA5-Land and station weather with Fire Weather Index components for the August 2025 Galician wildfires, a dataset record with no method of its own.

title: A Scalable Machine Learning Model for Continental-Scale Wildfire Risk Prediction
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
note: A whitepaper on a LightGBM wildfire risk model for Canada with fire weather indices among its features, so the System was a predictor only.

title: Advancing surface fuel representation for operational wildfire spread modeling at Météo-France
note: Dynamic surface fuels were added to the coupled Meso-NH and BLAZE spread model, and the Canadian based Fire Weather Indices used by Météo-France were related to simulated rate of spread, an evaluation of the System.

title: Prediction of Escaped Powerline‐Caused Fires in Alberta, Canada
venue: Earth s Future
note: Escaped powerline caused fires in Alberta from 1990 to 2023 were predicted with MaxEnt and machine learning from fire weather, fuels and topography, so the System was a predictor only.

title: Data and code for: Winter fire regime of the humid Eastern Black Sea forests of Türkiye (2012–2025)
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
note: A Zenodo package of data and code for a study of the winter fire regime of the Eastern Black Sea forests of Türkiye, with CEMS Fire Weather Index series as an input, a dataset record.

title: Next-day fire-detection forecasting for six Indian states: data set, stored predictions and code
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
note: A Zenodo dataset, stored predictions and code for next day satellite fire detection forecasting in Indian forest cells, a dataset record with no method of its own.

title: Linking wildfire ignitions to fire extent in mainland Portugal: temporal trends, territorial context, and fire-weather associations
venue: Journal of Pyrogeography
note: Fire Weather Index values of 489,226 Portuguese ignitions from 2001 to 2024 were tested for discriminating five fire size thresholds with temporal validation, its skill rising with fire size, a test against observed fire activity.

title: Do climate shocks induce technological change? Firm-level evidence from wildfire exposure and robot adoption
venue: Journal of Economic Studies
note: Wildfire exposure of Chinese manufacturing firms was instrumented with the Forest Fire Weather Index to study robot adoption, so the System was an instrument only.

title: Pre-registered hypotheses on a pre-computed wave calendar and extreme events – Stage 1 (filed before the end of wave W17)
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
note: A pre-registration filing of hypotheses on a geophysical resonance wave calendar and extreme events, with no data or method applied to the System.

title: Hurricane disturbance leads to elevated wildfire activity in the Gulf Coast region U.S.A.
venue: Natural Hazards
note: Wildfire activity after 30 Gulf Coast hurricane landfalls from 1992 to 2019 was analysed spatially, with no System component evaluated.

title: Future fire weather projections show the importance of mitigation and adaptation for dynamic fire management
venue: Natural hazards and earth system sciences
note: Future fire weather under three global warming levels was projected with the McArthur Forest Fire Danger Index from a perturbed physics ensemble, with no Canadian comparison.

title: Land-atmosphere feedback amplifies circulation-dominant fire weather risk over eastern Siberia
venue: Communications Earth & Environment
note: Circulation and land atmosphere feedback contributions to the 2004 to 2024 summer vapour pressure deficit trend over eastern Siberia were quantified, with no System component evaluated.

title: Enhancing Wildfire Resilience in the Rail Industry: Developing a Community Resilience Extreme Events Portal (CREEP)
note: A rail wildfire resilience portal combining danger indices and vulnerability scores for California rail segments was developed, with no System component evaluated.

title: Spatially clustered global wildfire trends and their climate, fuel and human drivers (2001–2025): A spatio-temporal trend-cluster attribution approach
venue: Geography and sustainability
note: Global burned area trend clusters from 2001 to 2025 were attributed to climate, fire weather, fuel and human drivers, so fire weather was a covariate only.
